en: A vintage postcard-style image showing a riverside or lakeside scene with tall palm trees in the foreground and more palms and low buildings or vegetation across the water. The image area has a printed caption in French that reads "Village de Memphis". There is also handwritten cursive text along the right margin. The overall style and coloration suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
